title: Explainable Iterative Data Visualization Refinement via an LLM Agent
abstract: arXiv:2604.15319v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Exploratory analysis of high-dimensional data relies on embedding the data into a low-dimensional space, based on which a visualization plot is produced to uncover meaningful structures and to communicate geometric and distributional data characteristics. Finding a suitable embedding algorithm configuration, particularly the hyperparameter setting, to produce a visualization plot that faithfully represents the underlying reality and encourages pattern discovery is labor-intensive and requires domain knowledge. To ease this burden, we propose an agentic AI pipeline that integrates rigorous quantitative assessment with large language model (LLM) based approximation of qualitative human judgment and insight. By treating visualization evaluation and hyperparameter optimization as a semantic task, our system generates a multi-faceted report that contextualizes quantitative metrics with descriptive summaries, and suggests actionable

tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于大语言模型智能体的AI流水线，将可视化评估和超参数优化视为语义任务，通过融合定量评估与对人类定性判断的近似，实现可解释的迭代式数据可视化优化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an LLM-agent-based AI pipeline that treats visualization evaluation and hyperparameter optimization as semantic tasks, integrating quantitative assessment with an approximation of qualitative human judgment to enable explainable iterative data visualization refinement.
